description: HEARTBEAT — announce that this session (a browser tab or an MCP agent) is live in the workspace, optionally on one scenario. Presence rows power the "who's here" roster: list_presence, plus presence[] on get_view /…

actor_label.description: Optional display name for the roster (e.g. "Claude — targeting pass").

focus_geo_id.description: Optional — the specific geography you are working (county fips / district / precinct id).

level.description: Optional — the office level you are looking at (president/senate/house/…), shown on the roster.

scenario_id.description: The sim you are working on (defaults to your bound sim from bind_session, else a workspace-level heartbeat).

state_fips.description: Optional — the 2-digit state FIPS you are focused on.

thread_key.description: Optional — the discussion thread you are reading or writing in (a list_threads thread key, e.g. "feature:county:42003" or "post:<comment_id>"). Shows as "viewing" on that thread for everyone in the room.

typing.description: Optional — true while you are composing in thread_key; shows a typing indicator there for ~8s per heartbeat.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: announce_presence
